data.name: Mech_OpensSystemSettings
data.value: Windows Settings opens; you confirm there.

data.name: Mech_SystemConsentPrompt
data.value: macOS shows its own confirmation dialog; you confirm there.

data.name: Mech_Unsupported
data.value: Changing the default browser is not supported on this system.

data.name: Status_AwaitingConsent
data.value: Waiting for you to answer the system dialog. {0} becomes the default as soon as you confirm.

data.name: Status_StillPending
data.value: The system dialog has not been answered yet, so nothing has changed. BrowserFlip is still watching: confirm the dialog and {0} becomes the default.

data.name: Status_PendingUnknown
data.value: BrowserFlip has stopped watching. The system dialog may still be open; if you confirm it, {0} will become the default even now. The default browser is unchanged so far.

data.name: Status_Declined
data.value: The change was declined, so the default browser is unchanged.

data.name: Status_RequestFailedUnknown
data.value: The request failed, and the system gave no reason.

data.name: Status_SecondProtocol
data.value: {0} now handles one of http / https. Confirm the second system dialog to finish the other.

data.name: Confirm_SetDefaultImmediate
data.value:
Make {0} the default browser?
This system applies the change immediately, without asking again, and BrowserFlip cannot undo it.

data.name: Settings_CapabilitiesHint
data.value: What this operating system and session actually allow. A disabled option above is disabled because of one of these, not because it failed.
